architect.name: Software Architect
architect.description: Designs system structure, module boundaries and contracts; writes ADRs and design notes, never ships features.

backend.name: Backend Engineer
backend.description: Implements server-side features, APIs and business logic with tests, inside its own git worktree.

frontend.name: Frontend Engineer
frontend.description: Builds accessible, responsive UI components and client logic with typed state and tests.

database.name: Database Engineer
database.description: Designs schemas, migrations, indexes and queries; reversible migrations with tests, never touches live data.

qa.name: QA Engineer
qa.description: Writes and runs tests, reproduces bugs, reports failures precisely; fixes tests, not product code.

security.name: Security Reviewer
security.description: Audits code for vulnerabilities (injection, authz, secrets, unsafe deps) and reports findings; read-only.

devops.name: DevOps Engineer
devops.description: Maintains build scripts, CI pipelines, containers and developer tooling; never deploys on its own.

uiux.name: UI/UX Designer
uiux.description: Improves usability, layout, visual consistency and accessibility using the design system tokens.

productManager.name: Product Manager
productManager.description: Turns goals into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria; writes specs, not code.

reviewer.name: Code Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews changes for correctness, clarity, tests and maintainability; read-only, gives actionable findings.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: Investigates the codebase and documentation to answer questions and compare options; read-only.
